findings.statement: Multiple reviewers agree that the Black Shark T11 earbuds deliver good sound quality with a 13 mm driver, though one reviewer notes the bass is 'good but not great'.
Gaming latency is praised as ultra-low by three sources, but one source reports a ~0.1 second delay in Free Fire, indicating possible game-specific inconsistency.
All sources that mention battery life agree on a total of up to 30 hours with the charging case, though one source notes this is a claimed figure not independently tested.
Two sources confirm the earbuds have ENC (Environmental Noise Cancellation) for calls, and one explicitly clarifies that this is not ANC (Active Noise Cancellation).
Fit and comfort are praised as lightweight and secure by two sources, but one reviewer reports a poor fit for their ears and a loose sliding mechanism that raises durability concerns.
Three sources highlight solid build quality with metal construction, a unique slide cover design, and RGB lighting, contributing to a premium gaming-oriented feel.
Two sources note the absence of a companion app and describe basic touch controls for calls and music, with reset performed by pressing both earbuds simultaneously.
One source reports poor microphone call quality where the other person cannot hear clearly, a claim not addressed by other sources.
Two sources confirm the earbuds support simultaneous connection to multiple devices and provide fast, responsive Bluetooth pairing with various phones.
One source uniquely reports that the side RGB lighting doubles as a battery level indicator, with flashing red lights signaling less than 10% charge.
One source mentions an IPX4 water resistance rating, making the earbuds suitable for workouts and outdoor use, a feature not discussed by other reviewers.
One source notes the semi-in-ear design allows outside noise to be heard, contrasting with in-ear models that isolate more, which may affect the listening experience.
Two sources from different regions (AED 169 and MAD 399) agree that the earbuds offer excellent value for money given the specifications.
